cards.name: 토리
cards.title: 작은 조정으로 다시 켜진 별빛
cards.focus: 돋보기로 조정한 뒤 시계의 별 표시등이 켜지는 결과

segments.action: Make actual USE of the worn magnifying loupe the main readable action. Tori visibly bends the torso forward and lowers the head toward the central screw until the brass loupe is close to the work (about one loupe diameter above the screw), looking DOWN THROUGH that lens directly at the screw. Narrow the eye without a lens in concentration. Keep head pitched downward so the optical axis points to the screw, never toward the viewer. With the other paw bracing the rigid housing, rotate the existing screwdriver handle one small quarter turn while its metal tip stays engaged in the SAME screw slot. A substantial purposeful lean and careful wrist movement, not an idle nod. No new tool, floating gear, changing screw or extra paw. End close to the work, inspecting through the loupe.

Still bent close to the screw, Tori shifts the head a few centimeters sideways to check the tiny adjustment through the worn loupe, keeping its optical axis aimed DOWN at the screw. Give a small pleased expression, then visibly straighten the torso and lift the head back to the exact starting position. The same screwdriver stays held in the same paw, tip engaged in the same fixed screw, and its handle eases back to the starting orientation with a precise wrist adjustment. Other paw keeps bracing. Lens, strap, two incisors, two paws, one tool and solid clock housing remain unchanged. No detached lens and no spontaneous clock movement.
